*   The scalar field is stored as a 3D array.
Initialize the current field state $V^{(t)}$ with the input scalar field values.
Create a temporary buffer $V^{(t+1)}$ initialized to zeros or copy $V^{(t)}$.
Identify the set of valid neighbors $\mathcal{W}_{i,j,k}$ within the $3 \times 3 \times 3$ neighborhood centered at $(i,j,k)$.
Calculate the number of valid neighbors $|\mathcal{W}_{i,j,k}|$.
